llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed classroom interaction coach that uses teacher-controlled class context and writes limited, confirmed classroom interaction notes.

dimensions.detail: The skill is designed for Chinese-language K12 classroom use, and the shared platform conventions explicitly state a China mainland Chinese K12 scope with localization requirements for other regions.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The package is Markdown and JSON reference material with no executable scripts, dependencies, remote payload retrieval, or install-time commands found in the inspected artifacts.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill has broad natural-language triggers, but they are classroom-interaction examples and the document gives adjacent-request exclusions for lesson planning, exercise generation, student analytics, and homework. The fallback generation of an in-class question chain is a documentation nuance, not hidden or purpose-mismatched behavior.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill declares persistent memory capability and classroom-record writeback, but it limits writes to aggregate interaction logs, requires teacher confirmation before storage, provides view/correct/delete/pause/share/export controls, and forbids recording student names in interactionLogs.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is classroom interaction support: questioning, participation paths, grouping, cold-call recovery, timing, and post-class observation. Its reads from lesson plans, class profile, student tiers, and weakness summaries fit that purpose, and its only declared write target is interactionLogs.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install this only for the intended Chinese-language K12 teacher workflow. Before using it with real classes, verify that persistent classroom records, cross-skill sharing, and any parent-facing outputs match your school and privacy rules; use the provided pause, delete, and sharing controls when records should not be retained or shared.
llm.findings:
[SDI-1] expected: Accepted only as a documentation clarity issue: the artifact says lesson-planner should provide question-chain drafts but allows a disclosed fallback when no draft exists, and logs flow to student-analyzer only as auxiliary aggregate evidence.
[SQP-1] expected: Downgraded: the activation phrases are broad but domain-specific to classroom interaction, and the artifact includes a trigger table plus adjacent-request exclusions.
[SDI-4] expected: Downgraded: the no-question boundary is aimed at exercises and stored assessment items; the skill separately discloses limited oral in-class prompting and requires checks before any temporary example is used.
[SQP-3] expected: Downgraded for shared/class-teaching-workspace.schema.json: Chinese-language schema text is consistent with the disclosed China mainland Chinese K12 context in shared/platform-conventions.md.
[SQP-3] expected: Downgraded for shared/grade-bands.md: the locale and language are consistent with the disclosed China mainland Chinese K12 context, though users outside that context should localize before deployment.
